sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety candidates for the UTC current-week window; AutoSpec ranked first, with AsyncOPD and Poisoned Playbooks as same-table backups.
Main agent read the arXiv abstract/submission history, HTML full text, TeX source sections, tables, algorithm, evaluation, ablation, discussion, and related AgentSpec context.
Article is pure Markdown with more than 5000 Chinese characters, no external image embeds, and evidence represented through tables, formulas, pseudocode, and Mermaid.
